status: complete: 36/36 authors, all independent reviews, supplemental native audit, export integrity and timeline browser QA completed

limits.policy: retain every failure; no replacement; stop further scheduling for a reproduced infrastructure defect until repaired uniformly

order.development: A/B alternating on dev cases, C after implementation; exploratory sequential time confound disclosed
order.holdout: three repetitions per case, Latin square ABC/BCA/CAB; rotate across tasks; strictly serial author execution

timing.primary: dispatch to independently accepted HTML; generation, inspection and repair time all recorded, no free reviewer work
timing.author_wall: supervisor monotonic start to process exit; not exact model completion
timing.first_draft: first observed parseable structurally complete candidate; 100ms polling with maximum gap recorded
timing.independent_review: separate spans; common protocol all cohorts; accepted time null on any quality failure
timing.native_cli: receipt duration fields; absent browser sub-stage fields null
timing.clock: monotonic duration, UTC for correlation; public stdout arrival can lag execution
timing.setup: clone/package/auth setup measured separately, same policy all variants

quality.schema: native showcase plus common B validation of same JSON
quality.source: claim-by-claim entailment, directions, conditions, runtime/control/persistence boundaries, all requested scope
quality.visual: actual delivered HTML light/dark 1440x900 and 1920x1080; native full viewport gates retained; independent actual screenshot inspection
quality.first_pass: first complete candidate separately evaluated; final success does not imply first pass

isolation.author: fresh CODEX_HOME/HOME, packaged version Skill only, read-only target and package, OS-denied access to other /private/tmp and user home; verify canary denied
isolation.raw_logs: external private evidence root, excluded from git; reasoning events discarded before persistence
isolation.host_chrome: same Chrome wrapper --no-sandbox inside external seatbelt; crash reporter disabled; deterministic checks unchanged
isolation.network: same inherited network policy; no extra providers
isolation.cache: new session each run; OS/provider caches uncontrolled, observed usage reported
isolation.shell_tmp: TMPPREFIX=<workspace>/tmp/zsh; positive heredoc and negative private-read preflight required

analysis.pairing: per task C/A and C/B; equal task weights, median/range and all samples; no reliable P95/noninferiority claims
analysis.failed_runs: failure/censoring, never zero latency or silently excluded

tasks.selection_rationale: Controlled fixture with an entry/config/runtime split, a waiting queue, a concurrency-capped worker pool, retry behavior, and a terminal dead-letter branch. It exercises a directed runtime graph without relying on package conventions.
tasks.prompt: Create an architecture diagram from this repository's source. Show how a tenant request enters the gateway, waits in a queue, and is processed by workers. Make the configured authentication, billing, and result boundaries visible. Keep the concurrency limit and the dead-letter failure path legible, including the retry relationship.

tasks.selection_rationale: Controlled fixture with a long Chinese component label and a policy-driven data path: audit query, field redaction, object storage, notification, and a separately represented review boundary.
tasks.prompt: 请阅读这个仓库，为刚接手项目的同事画一张架构图，说明审计导出请求的入口、导出计划与执行过程，以及配置策略和数据边界。请覆盖脱敏、结果输出、完成通知和人工复核相关职责，区分源代码实际实现与仅有配置或声明的部分。图中请保留完整服务名称：跨租户审计日志导出与脱敏编排服务（含异步导出、留存策略和人工复核边界），放在适合阅读的位置。

tasks.selection_rationale: Small public OSS module with a compact but nontrivial control/data relationship: factory state, queue admission, asynchronous execution, completion-driven scheduling, map fan-out, and clear-queue behavior.
tasks.prompt: Read this repository and create an architecture diagram of its concurrency limiting module. Show the public factory and its returned limiter, the queue that holds pending work, the active task runner, and the completion path that admits the next item. Include the configurable concurrency boundary and the separate map and clear-queue capabilities.

tasks.selection_rationale: Different controlled fixture reserved for evaluation. It has a policy gate with a review side path plus a bounded retrying worker pipeline, so it tests transfer beyond the development queue and export patterns.
tasks.prompt: Create an architecture diagram from this repository's source for the image transformation pipeline. Show the request entry point, format policy, queued work, worker reads from the configured original-image boundary, transformation, and writes to the configured derived-image boundary. Unsupported formats must go to the manual review queue, while any caught worker failure retries up to the configured attempt count and then becomes a failed job.

tasks.selection_rationale: Small public OSS library with a different structure from the development tasks: environment-derived feature state, a fluent context builder, and a parallel named-export surface sharing formatter primitives.
tasks.prompt: Read this repository and create an architecture diagram of the terminal color formatting library. Show how process environment detection controls whether formatting is enabled, how the default fluent API builds a chain of styles, and how chained calls produce formatted text. Also show the separate named color export surface and its formatting behavior.

tasks.selection_rationale: Public multi-package OSS repository with a request-time architecture: CLI options feed a middleware factory, which chooses indexed or local lookup and then applies encoding, MIME, cache, fallback, and response behavior.
tasks.prompt: Create an architecture diagram from this repository's source for the sirv static file server. Show the CLI entry and option handling, the middleware factory, request path resolution, the production file index versus development filesystem lookup, MIME and cache header construction, and the response stream. Include optional compressed asset selection, SPA fallback, and the 404 path.
